name: analyze-project
description: Auto-detect the host project stack (frontend, backend, DB, auth, routes). Trigger: /aiqa-analyzeproject or analyze project or detect project or what stack

name: analyze-story
description: Parse one or more user stories and extract acceptance criteria, scenarios, risks, and edge cases. Multiple stories are merged. Trigger: /aiqa-analyzestory <story-file> [story-file2] ... or analyze story or parse story or extract AC

name: full-workflow
description: Run all 9 QA phases end-to-end across one or more user stories. Trigger: /aiqa-fullworkflow <story-file> [story-file2] ... or full workflow or run all or test this story

name: generate-test-cases
description: Generate Arabic XLSX + MD test cases from one or more user stories (Phase 2). Trigger: /aiqa-generatetestcases <story-file> [story-file2] ... or generate test cases or test cases

name: generate-e2e
description: Generate Playwright E2E test files (Page Object + spec) from one or more stories (Phase 3). Trigger: /aiqa-generatee2e <story-file> [story-file2] ... or generate e2e or write playwright tests or create test files

name: generate-test-data
description: Generate JSON test data for all E2E suites (Phase 4). Trigger: /aiqa-generatetestdata or generate test data or test data

name: analyze-bugs
description: Triage test failures and generate Arabic bug reports (Phase 6). Trigger: /aiqa-analyzebugs or analyze bugs or bug analysis or triage

name: generate-report
description: Generate final QA summary report in HTML, MD, and XLSX (Phase 7). Trigger: /aiqa-generatereport or generate report or create report or show results

name: fix-bugs
description: Fix bugs by editing source code and retesting each fix (Phase 8). Trigger: /aiqa-fixbugs or fix bugs or fix issues

name: regression-test
description: Re-run the baseline test suite and compare with previous run. Trigger: /aiqa-regressiontest or regression test or re-run tests or diff tests

name: security-scan
description: Run OWASP-style security validation on detected endpoints. Trigger: /aiqa-securityscan or security scan or security check or OWASP

name: accessibility-scan
description: Run a11y audit on detected pages. Trigger: /aiqa-accessibilityscan or accessibility scan or a11y check or check accessibility

name: autonomous-run
description: Run autonomous QA loop that plans, acts, observes, and reflects. Trigger: /aiqa-autorun or autonomous run or auto test or run loop

name: reset-framework
description: Wipe all test outputs from TestResult/ and reset QA history log. Trigger: /aiqa-reset or reset framework or clear results or fresh cycle
